stage3fInheritance.rule: Stage 3G reads these; it never rewrites a Stage 3F artifact, certificate, hash, fact, the Decision Evaluation Contract, authority or the expert roster. A Stage 3G result that bears on a frozen fact is reported as new Stage 3G evidence, never as an edit of the fact.

calSelection.rule: the NEW variant with the highest CAL top-1; ties within 1e-9 -> fewer columns

disclosures.OBSERVABILITY: entity positions are exposed because Forge declares perfect information and renders every entity; this is an environment declaration, not a general claim about other games
disclosures.SURFACE_RETREAT_TIE_BREAK: the frozen Stage 3F symmetric RETREAT breaks distance ties with the canonical frame, whose digest reads entity id strings; renaming entities inside the world can move RETREAT (rate reported per partition as SURFACE_RETREAT_ID_DEPENDENT_RATE). The Stage 3G representation is invariant to identities for a fixed offered action set.
disclosures.LEVEL_COVERAGE: canonical admission order: STAGE3G_HOLDOUT covers the low curriculum levels in data.levels
disclosures.UNEXPOSED_ATTRIBUTES: entity value, cost, risk and non-actor health remain UNAVAILABLE; errors they would explain appear in the residual taxonomy as PRIVILEGED_ONLY only when a kernel relation separates them, otherwise as UNKNOWN
